name: new
declaration: unsafe fn new (lock : & 'rwlock RwLock < T >) -> LockResult < RwLockReadGuard < 'rwlock , T > >
documentation:
Creates a new instance of `RwLockReadGuard<T>` from a `RwLock<T>`.

 # Safety

 This function is safe if and only if the same thread has successfully and safely called
 `lock.inner.read()`, `lock.inner.try_read()`, or `lock.inner.downgrade()` before
 instantiating this object.
rules: Calling `RwLockReadGuard::new(lock)` is safe if and only if the same thread has successfully and safely called `lock.inner.read()`, `lock.inner.try_read()`, or `lock.inner.downgrade()` before instantiating the guard.
